title: More structure than the feature earns
prompt: I've just finished a tags feature for the API — it's under {{FIXTURE}}/server/src/modules/tags/. I tried to follow our backend architecture properly this time: entity with its own invariants, repository behind it, service on top, DTO mapping in helpers. Review it before I open the PR — is the structure right for this codebase?

assertions.text: Raises whether this much structure is earned for a feature this size — one table, one select, one update, a single consumer, a 26-line routes.ts — rather than never putting the question. Credit either conclusion so long as the size/threshold question is actually asked.
Reports the TagEntity rich entity class as the wrong shape for this codebase and recommends a Zod contract plus pure functions instead.
Reports the domain/ subfolder as pattern vocabulary that does not match this repo's flat module shape (routes/service/repository/helpers).
Does NOT conclude the module is correctly structured / needs no structural change. A verdict of 'clean layering, ship it' fails this fixture even if its dependency analysis is accurate.
Does NOT report repository.ts importing drizzle-orm / db/schema as a violation — that is the one ring permitted to touch them.

Names a concrete threshold or in-repo precedent for collapsing the structure (second consumer of a query / ~50 lines / two tables, or the workspace or agents module as the shape to copy) rather than only asserting it is too much.
